note: GHL Lead-Enrichment Marketplace App. MVP for beta users. Numbered in the JAK-100 block to avoid colliding with the existing JAK-001..004 core Jake MVP tickets. Critical-path spine first (101-108). 150+ are deferred (post-beta): captured but NOT to be worked yet.

tickets.title: Project ticket store (SQLite in-repo)
tickets.body: Stand up a project-local ticket system that travels with the repo. SQLite DB at tickets/tickets.db + a tiny `tix` CLI (add/list/done/show/export) + generated tickets/TICKETS.md human export. Mirror the AskZack inbox.db/inbox.md pattern: DB is source of truth, .md is generated (don't hand-edit). Seed all tickets below from this file. Optionally backfill the existing JAK-001..004 core Jake MVP tickets as done from projects journal / jake.md if quick. Mark this ticket done once the store + seed + export exist.

tickets.title: GHL app scaffolding + Doppler config + env helper
tickets.body: Create the ghl-enrichment module structure inside Jake's existing TS/Express/tsyringe server. Wire Doppler for GHL client_id/secret/webhook-secret. Add/confirm a single canonical env helper (isProduction/isStaging/isDev) following the Automator env pattern. No business logic yet — just the skeleton, DI container registration, and config.

tickets.title: OAuth install/callback + per-location token store (encrypted)
tickets.body: Implement the GHL OAuth 2.0 install link + /oauth/callback code exchange. Store per-location access + refresh tokens encrypted at rest in Postgres (ghl_installations). Handle re-install (upsert). Follow secret-storage feedback rules — never plaintext tokens.

tickets.title: Token refresh service
tickets.body: Auto-refresh access tokens before expiry; persist new tokens. Handle revoked/uninstalled locations gracefully (mark inactive, stop processing). Centralize so every GHL call gets a valid token.

tickets.title: GHL API client (axios, per-location auth, retries, rate-limit)
tickets.body: axios-based GHL API v2 client. Injects the correct per-location token, handles rate-limit backoff + retries. Methods needed by MVP: get contact, update contact custom fields, create note, create custom field, list custom fields. Thin and testable.

tickets.title: Install lifecycle: auto-provision custom fields + welcome note; uninstall
tickets.body: On install: auto-create the canonical Jake custom fields in the sub-account (via API), persist their field ids (ghl_custom_fields), and drop a welcome note. On uninstall webhook: mark location inactive and stop processing. User never hand-builds fields.

tickets.title: Webhook receiver (ContactCreate/Update) + signature verify + enqueue
tickets.body: POST /webhooks/ghl endpoint. Verify GHL signature, return 200 fast, enqueue an enrichment job to BullMQ. Subscribe to ContactCreate (ContactUpdate optional/flagged off for MVP). No enrichment inline — queue only.

tickets.title: Enrichment worker: queue -> Jake engine -> write-back + idempotency
tickets.body: BullMQ worker: load contact from GHL, run the EXISTING Jake enrichment engine, normalize, write results back to the provisioned custom fields + one 'Jake Enrichment' note. Idempotent — never double-enrich the same contact (check ghl_enrichment_events). Record the event.

tickets.title: Field mapping module (canonical Jake->GHL field set + output mapping)
tickets.body: One place defining the canonical Jake custom field set (name, key, type) AND the mapping from enrichment engine output to field values. Used by both install-provisioning (JAK-105) and write-back (JAK-107). A mapping change here must never leak elsewhere.

tickets.title: Usage metering (per-location enrichment log)
tickets.body: Record each enrichment per location (ghl_enrichment_events already carries the row) with a cost estimate. This feeds future tier caps + billing. No enforcement yet — just accurate counts per location per period.

tickets.title: Dev/staging safety: mock GHL, no real writes off prod
tickets.body: HARD RULE (mirrors Automator buyer-dispatch): dev never writes to a real GHL sub-account. Local mock GHL client + single echo sink. Staging uses a dedicated test sub-account only. Real writes only in prod for installed locations. Gate at the client layer, not per-call.

tickets.title: Failure handling: retries, dead-letter, error surfacing
tickets.body: Retry transient failures (GHL 429/5xx, enrichment timeouts). Dead-letter jobs that exhaust retries; record the error on ghl_enrichment_events. Make failures visible (log + status view), not silent.

tickets.title: Minimal install/usage status view
tickets.body: Thin view (reuse existing React/MUI admin shell) listing installed locations + enrichment counts + recent failures. Internal-only for now. Keep minimal.

tickets.title: [LATER] GHL Marketplace listing + approval requirements
tickets.body: DEFERRED — post-beta. Research current GHL marketplace public-listing + approval requirements (logo, description, screenshots, demo video, scopes justification, support email, privacy/terms URLs, revenue-share terms). Prepare assets and submit for public review. Do NOT work until Zequi says beta is validated. Beta runs on private install links, no review.

tickets.title: [LATER] Tier pricing + billing + enrichment caps + unit economics
tickets.body: DEFERRED. Define tiers + caps (protect margin — enrichment has per-lookup cost). Model cost-per-enrichment vs price. Implement billing (Stripe or GHL native marketplace billing) and enforce per-tier enrichment caps using the metering from JAK-109. Pricing decision is Zequi's (do not propose tiers unprompted).

tickets.title: [LATER] Onboarding: white-glove + self-serve field-mapping guide
tickets.body: DEFERRED. Optional 15-20 min white-glove session flow + a self-serve guide for anyone who wants to map fields themselves or route everything into a single note for their AI to read.

tickets.title: [LATER] Privacy Policy + Terms pages for Jake
tickets.body: DEFERRED (needed before public marketplace listing / A2P). Reuse the SublimadosYa scoped single-block pattern (bilingual, GHL-ready) to produce Jake privacy + terms pages, including SMS/A2P consent language.

tickets.title: [LATER] CRM upsell bundle (GHL SaaS resale + AskZoe concierge)
tickets.body: DEFERRED. Package: resell GHL sub-accounts via SaaS mode + enrichment, with AskZoe as the 'do you need a CRM?' concierge. Business/packaging work, post-beta.
